keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «학교의 황금 두루마리가 사라졌다(문제)» 와 «훌륭한 닌자는 근육만이 아니라 눈과 머리를 쓴다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the school's golden scroll disappeared) and the lesson (a great ninja uses his eyes and mind, not only his muscles). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Kenji, the big kids, the master, a raccoon

One night, the school's golden scroll disappeared!
went away so no one could see or find it
found a fat raccoon sleeping on the scroll
a long piece of paper that is rolled up

qs.q: Why did the raccoon take the golden scroll?
opts: It wanted to make a warm bed.
It wanted to read the scroll.
The big kids gave the scroll to it.
evs: The big kids laughed at him every day.
The raccoon had taken it to make a warm bed.
The strongest students ran into the forest to search, but they found nothing.
He could not jump as high as the others, and he was not very strong.
why: 너구리는 따뜻한 잠자리를 만들려고 두루마리를 가져갔어요. 덩치 큰 아이들이 너구리에게 줬다는 말은 없어요.
The raccoon took the scroll to make a warm bed. The text never says the big kids gave it away.

qs.q: The text says Kenji "noticed everything." What does this mean?
qs.qko: 켄지는 "noticed everything"이라고 나와요. 이 말은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: He saw even very small things.
evs: He saw a little flour and some tiny footprints.
He could not jump as high as the others, and he was not very strong.
From that day, nobody laughed at Kenji again.
why: 켄지는 바닥에 떨어진 아주 조금의 밀가루와 작은 발자국까지 보았어요. 그러니 «아주 작은 것까지 알아차렸다» 는 뜻이에요.
Kenji saw a little flour and tiny footprints on the floor. So he saw even very small things.

qs.q: How was Kenji able to find the scroll?
qs.qko: 켄지는 어떻게 두루마리를 찾을 수 있었나요?
opts: He looked closely at the floor instead of running into the forest.
He was faster than the strongest students.
The master told him where it was.
evs: The strongest students ran into the forest to search, but they found nothing.
Kenji was the smallest student at the secret ninja school in the mountains.
Kenji stayed behind and looked closely at the floor.
From that day, nobody laughed at Kenji again.
why: 힘센 학생들은 숲으로 달려갔지만 아무것도 찾지 못했어요. 켄지는 남아서 바닥을 자세히 살폈어요. 이 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
The strong students ran into the forest and found nothing. Kenji stayed and looked closely at the floor. Put these two clues together.

ends: Kenji teaches the big kids how to look for clues.
켄지가 덩치 큰 아이들에게 단서 찾는 법을 가르쳐요.
The raccoon becomes the school's sneaky new pet.
너구리가 학교의 장난꾸러기 새 반려동물이 돼요.

write.src: “I can’t <u>jump very high</u>, but I can <u>notice small things</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «못 하는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can't do and what you can do instead in English.

img.cover: In a dim wooden kitchen lit by a round paper lantern, a small boy with a short black topknot in a dark blue ninja suit with a white belt kneels on the floor and smiles at a fat raccoon curled up asleep on a golden scroll, while a trail of tiny white floury footprints leads to it and two tall students peek in through the doorway.

scenes.1: On a moonlit night at a mountain ninja school, tall students in black ninja suits run toward a dark forest holding paper lanterns, while a small boy with a short black topknot in a dark blue ninja suit with a white belt stays in the doorway and stares at an empty wooden stand.
scenes.3: In a sunny wooden hall, an old master with a long gray mustache in a brown robe gently pats the head of a small boy with a short black topknot in a dark blue ninja suit with a white belt, who holds the golden scroll with both hands, while the other students bow and a fat raccoon peeks out from behind a pillar.

alt.1: The big students run to the forest, but Kenji stays.
alt.3: The master smiles at Kenji, who holds the scroll.
alt.cover: Kenji finds a raccoon sleeping on the golden scroll.
